name: Tzolk'in: The Mayan Calendar

categories.label: Victory points on score track (incl. 4th Food Day temples)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track (gồm thưởng đền ở Food Day cuối)
categories.hint: Running VP: buildings, skulls at Chichen Itza, Food Day temple steps and highest-on-temple bonus, minus 3 per unfed worker. Can be negative.

categories.label: Total corn after converting all resources
categories.labelVi: Tổng ngô sau khi đổi mọi tài nguyên
categories.hint: Convert every resource to corn at the market exchange rate, add leftover corn; then 1 VP per 4 corn (rounded down).

categories.label: Crystal skulls left
categories.hint: 3 VP per crystal skull you still hold.

categories.label: Monument end-game points
categories.hint: Total VP printed effects of your monuments at game end.

tiebreakers.description: Most workers still on the gears (not in front of you or the bank).
If still tied, all tied players win.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends after the 4th Food Day (one full revolution of the Tzolk'in gear). Final scoring order per rulebook: convert resources to corn, 1/4 VP per corn, 3 VP per skull, then monument points. Temple end-of-game bonus (upper-right number; tied highest players split half) is scored on the last Food Day and is already on the track. Monument values are printed on tiles and entered as one number.

sources.title: Tzolk'in: The Mayan Calendar Rulebook (CGE, via 1j1ju)
